Equipment:Forced draft fan
 FD FAn
 TLT- USA

This document out lines the details equipment 
Minor maintenance (P1-Y1), required for FD fan (this fan is used for 
supply the boiler with combustion air). This minor maintenance performed every 
year as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first 
draft initiated by eng: Abdalla M. Abdalla. reviewed by directed by eng: 
Gamal Arafa and revised by quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil at edec, 
accepted by general director eng. M. Abd el-salam and approved by eng: Michael 
Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this 
 FD FAN

Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor 
 of this FD FAN

The FD FAN must be isolated mechanically by 
 closing suction and delivery valve

Disconnect the fan side half coupling from the rotor and inspect both the fan 
 side and the motor side half couplings for wear. Clean all parts and 
 re-grease. jacking fixtures are required to remove the coupling hubs. In 
 addition to these fixtures, the hydraulic jacks are required. Torquing 
 requirements for bolts. Check the alignment of the motor, intermediate shaft 
 (if applicable), and the couplings.
Wear or damage may affect the fan balance
Check all lube oil and hydraulic system hoses, piping, and fittings for leaks
Check and repair as required HOUSING & INLET BOX
Check and adjust as required COUPLING WEAR & ALIGNMENT
Check and adjust as required DAMPER BLADES & LINKAGES
Check and adjust as required ROTOR BODY BOUND BOLTS
Check and adjust as required SHAFT BEARINGS & SEALS

Introduction
This document out lines the details equipment 
Minor maintenance (P1-Y1), required for FD fan (this fan is used for 
supply the boiler with combustion air). This minor maintenance performed every

Technical Specification of SL FADRAFT
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this 
 FD FAN
Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor 
 of this FD FAN
The FD FAN must be isolated mechanically by 
 closing suction and delivery valve
Tools and Equipment
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller,
Suitable lifting device, Feeler gauge
Hammer,
 Dial indicator,
 Tourqe wrench
Work to be Carried Out
Disconnect the fan side half coupling from the rotor and inspect both the fan 
 side and the motor side half couplings for wear. Clean all parts and 
 re-grease. jacking fixtures are required to remove the coupling hubs. In 
 addition to these fixtures, the hydraulic jacks are required. Torquing 
 requirements for bolts. Check the alignment of the motor, intermediate shaft 
 (if applicable), and the couplings.
Wear or damage may affect the fan balance
Check all lube oil and hydraulic system hoses, piping, and fittings for leaks
Check ROTOR & BLADE LINERS
Check and repair as required HOUSING & INLET BOX
Check and adjust as required COUPLING WEAR & ALIGNMENT
Check and adjust as required DAMPER BLADES & LINKAGES
